title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘in the short to medium term’
part_context: Reiterates the need to develop measures to ensure gas supply at a mitigated cost for those sectors which cannot rely substantially on electrification <del>in the short to medium term</del>; calls for diversified and reliable partnerships in line with the Union’s security, interests and the RePowerEU roadmap;
